content: मल्ल {%a.%} [मल्ल्-अच्] .²1 Strong, athletic, robust; <ls>Ki. 18. 8</ls>. .²2 Good, excellent. .{@-ल्लः@} .²1 A strong man. .²2 An athlete, a boxer, wrestler; प्रभुर्मल्लो मल्लाय <ls>Mbh.</ls> .²3 A drinking-vessel, cup. .²4 The remnants of an oblation. .²5 The cheek and temple. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a mixed tribe (wrestlers) born of an outcast Kṣatriya by a Kṣatriya woman; झल्लो मल्लश्च राजन्याद् व्रात्यान्निच्छिविरेव च <ls>Ms. 10. 22</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 45</ls>. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a country. .{@-मल्ला@} .²1 A woman. .²2 The Arabian jasmine. .²3 Ornamenting the person with cosmetics or coloured unguents.
